origin: Social media posts are high-stakes irreversible actions. LinkedIn cannot un-send a post; Substack newsletters reach all subscribers. Before content moves from draft -> ready -> published, three independent gates must agree.
description: GATE rule for social-media content. Composes content-format-check + LLM judge panel (tone, IP safety, narrative clarity) + metadata completeness. Panel rule: ALL judges PASS or WARN, AND no more than 1 WARN, otherwise BLOCK.

judges.lens: hook + CTA legibility for context-free reader

panel_rule: All judges return PASS or WARN, AND <=1 WARN total; otherwise BLOCK.
applies_to: any draft destined for substack | linkedin | twitter | reddit | instagram
litmus: Run HOW.py before status=ready. PASS = ship. WARN = human review. BLOCK = revise and re-run.
